photos.c: Below: Heptathlete Julie Hollman set a tremendous score of over 6000 points in the Multistars Meet at Desenzano del Garda, Italy, in May but was beset by problems when the major Games came around later in the year and unable to reproduce her best form.
Competition in 2003 ranged from Women's Southern League matches through to the Paris World Championships for British Heptathlete star Julie Hollman.
